---
title: "OS non-proportional hazards — fitting"
subtitle: "Supporting analysis with a time-varying treatment effect"
format: html
---

- `rstanarm` default priors, not the SAP priors of the main model.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

imputation_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results", "imputations"
)
results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "02-non-proportional-hazards", "results"
)
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-nph
#| include: false

for (index in seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  fitting_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(imputation_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index))
  ) |>
    complete(1) |>
    mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2)) |>
    # Zero follow-up is dropped from fitting only; standardization keeps it.
    filter_out(survival_time_days == 0)

  model <- stan_surv(
    formula = Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
      tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3) +
      ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
    data = fitting_data,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 1000L,
    warmup = 500L,
    cores = 4L,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000
  )

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
